scope: Resource-feasible formal Cosmos3-Nano wrist-only generation-pathway LoRA controller
summary: A strict 500-step, 93-frame Nano LoRA profile is locally implemented for an even allocation of at least two GPUs, but it has not launched because the verified DCP and measured all-record dataset audit are still pending.
evidence: The current official Cosmos Framework FAQ explicitly supports enabling LoRA on the Nano vision SFT recipe to reduce optimizer memory.

The profile uses the official vision_sft_super generation-adapter values: rank 16, alpha 32, q/k/v/o generation-MoE targets, adapter-only optimizer selection, no EMA, full activation checkpointing, and context parallelism 2.
The formal objective remains 500 optimizer steps, 93 frames, 45,056 packed tokens, 50 warmup steps, and deterministic cuDNN settings.
The launcher accepts two GPUs for formal_lora but rejects odd counts, records both physical GPU selection and allocator configuration, and still requires the accepted dataset-lineage audit.
All 64 Cosmos3-focused CPU tests pass in 0.62 seconds; targeted Ruff, py_compile, and whitespace checks pass.
lessons: An official adapter pathway can remove the eight-GPU optimizer-state blocker without weakening data-lineage or held-out quality gates.
Resource feasibility is not model quality evidence; the profile remains NOT STARTED until real backpropagation completes.
limitations: No Nano LoRA optimization step, trained checkpoint, validation generation, or demo exists from this profile.
Two-A800 fit is expected from LoRA plus full activation/context sharding but remains unproven until the gated real smoke/formal launch.
Cosmos3-Super remains a larger 64B fallback, but its official generator LoRA recipe and 133 GB checkpoint have not been provisioned on this host.
next_actions: Complete indexed Nano checkpoint recovery and DCP conversion, complete and audit all wrist-only records, then run the existing two-step smoke.
If smoke proves load/backpropagation, launch formal_lora on the two free A800 GPUs and evaluate every validation sample before any demo promotion.
If Nano fails the frozen strict validation after checkpoint selection, provision the official Cosmos3-Super LoRA lane rather than publishing a weak result.
